name: @acc/broadcast-desktop
author: ASC
description: ASC Broadcast — desktop (macOS + Windows) Electron shell for the ASC scoring cockpit

scripts.pack:mac: node scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.cjs mac && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dir --universal --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.cjs mac && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.cjs win && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --publish never
